basic_details.job_title: Gauhati University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 IT Assistant, Programme Director and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Programme Director (S T Radar Centre), Technical Officer (Instrumentation and USIC), Scientific Officer (Communication & Journalism) and 4 more
basic_details.short_information: Gauhati University (GU), Guwahati, Assam, has invited applications for 7 posts in 7 roles under Advt No. NTS-15/2026. The posts include Programme Director (S T Radar Centre), Technical Officer (Instrumentation and USIC), Scientific Officer (Communication & Journalism), Scientific Officer (Sattriya) and 3 more. The online application is open from 19 November 2026 to 10 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only; fee once paid shall not be refunded.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Post-wise: Master's Degree with Ph.D. in Atmospheric Science and 12 years' research experience (Programme Director); First Class B.Tech./M.Sc. Instrumentation with 5 years' experience (Technical Officer); Master's Degree with relevant experience (Scientific Officers, Superintendent); B.E./B.Tech with 5 years' procurement experience (IT Assistant)

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Master's Degree in Physics or Atmospheric Science, followed by a Ph.D. in Atmospheric Science from a recognized University or Institution; A strong record of high-quality, peer-reviewed research publications; Demonstrated research leadership and ability to formulate and implement a strategic R&D agenda for weather and climate forecasting, particularly in Northeast India. Experience required: At least 12 years of research experience after obtaining the Ph.D in relevant areas of atmospheric science, weather and climate research or allied disciplines. Age limit: Maximum 55 years. Pay: Rs. 1,31,400-2,17,100 (Academic Level 13A) Plus other usual allowances as admissible under G.U. Rules. Qualification required: First Class in B.Tech. in Electrical/ Electronics/Instrument

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,31,400-2,17,100 (Academic Level 13A) for Programme Director; Rs. 30,000-1,10,000 + GP for Technical Officer, Scientific Officers and Superintendent; Pay Band Rs. 14,000-60,500 + GP Rs. 8,700 for IT Assistant

how_to_apply: Apply online only through the Non-Teaching Recruitment Candidate Portal https://gauhatint.samarth.edu.in/ (via www.gauhati.ac.in).
Register with a valid email id and mobile number, then fill the online application form; fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory.
Pay the application fee online; no other mode of payment is accepted.
Send a duly signed hard copy of the completed application to The Registrar, Gauhati University, Guwahati-781014, Assam by 17.12.2026 (5:00 pm).
Attach the e-generated fee receipt, self-attested certificates and NOC wherever applicable.
Superscribe the envelope: Application for the post of (Name of the post as per advertisement), Gauhati University, Advt. No. NTS-15/2026.
important_instructions: Employed candidates may send an ADVANCE COPY within the closing date; the original forwarded by employer and/or NOC must reach within ten (10) days from the last date Applications received late, incomplete or without fee will be summarily rejected No changes entertained after the online application is submitted Registration is provisional; candidature may be rejected at any stage or even after joining if information is false University not responsible for late/non receipt of call letters due to postal delay University reserves the right to withdraw any post and to fill or not fill the posts
